snippet.title: Mahi Ta Mera | Ibrahim Sulayman | Hassaan Malik - Mansoor Malangi (Official Music Video)
snippet.description:
#mahitamera #khanghara #punjabisong

“Mahi Ta Mera”  our take on the timeless Punjabi folk sound associated with the legendary Mansoor Malangi Sahab.


We wanted to keep the soul of the original close to our hearts while bringing our own sound, feel, and interpretation to it. From the live instruments to the way we produced it, this song became more than just a collaboration, it became a journey into a sound and culture we both wanted to experience.

A little piece of Jhang, Punjab, and our love for folk music.

Mahi Ta Mera is yours. ❤️

https://open.spotify.com/track/1umCymfqbkijhZRmk5jk7R?si=b738e5bfaf6c4819

Music Produced/Mix Mastered: Ibrahim Sulayman
Vocalist : Ibrahim Sulayman, Hassaan Malik
Banjo Played by: khalil Channal
Video Direction/Concept: Ibrahim Sulayman
DOP: Muhammad Farooq, Aftaab Hussain, Jamal
Editor: Omer Bari 
Additional Footage by: Awais Bhullar 

Ibrahim Sulayman
http://instagram.com/ibrahimsulaymann

Hassaan Malik

https://www.tiktok.com/@hassaanmalik.officiall



Lyrics/translation
Mahi ta mera phullan da shauqi
My beloved is fond of flowers.

Maula chaa laaye rang ve khan aa
May God bless you with colors, Khan.

Khan ghara de bannd ve khanaa
Khan, get me a band (necklace) made.

Mahi ta mera khala bahun dur ay
My beloved is standing very far away.

Allah jaane kehri gallon majbur ay
Allah knows for what reason he is helpless.

Meri na sukdi hanj ve khan aa
My tears just won’t stop flowing, Khan.

Khan ghara de bannd ve khanaa
Khan, get me a band (necklace) made.

Mahi mere de hath vich ghariyan
My beloved has a watch on his hand.

Aukhiyan laaiyan tor na charhiyan
We struggled to build a bond, but could not reach our destination.

Eho taa khaa gia gham ve khan aa
This sorrow is what has consumed me, Khan.

Khan ghara de bannd ve khanaa
Khan, get me a band (necklace) made.

Mein dhole di manng ve khan aa
I am a supplication for my beloved.

Gulab de phul le laye
I bought roses.

Allah chaa taufeeq deway
May Allah grant the ability to do so.

Banda sajna nu mul le lay
A person should win the heart of their beloved.

Baghan vich mor honda
There is a peacock in the gardens.

Asi tere piche kyon rulde
Why do we wander around for you?

Jey koi tere jeya hor honda
If there were someone else like you.


Mein dhole di manng ve khan aa
I am a supplication for my beloved.
Khan ghara de bannd ve khanaa
Khan, get me a band (necklace) made.
